limits: Not a production Oop-only ABI; the semantic fixture still uses old packet entry glue and bootstrap registration.
Only test dispatch contexts enable size immediates. Production reflection, GC, root enumeration, images, stackless slots and native loading are not adapted or qualified.
Benchmarks compare core algorithms, excluding message lookup/packet glue; the earlier separate C/Rust transport experiment covers ABI feasibility only.

All lanes use real ObjectMemory and Symbols. Name validation reads Id allocation geometry because this test owner is colocated inside Id; the final functional ownership boundary remains to be designed and measured.
Allocation benchmark includes actual object allocation and preallocated result-vector pushes, excludes retirement; no automatic GC.
Prepared names are constructed outside timers in both prepared-miss lanes; fresh-name cases include construction, byte copy and immediate disposal only in the Oop lane.
No compiler CPU competitor was started during final serial timing runs. Other desktop processes were active.
Two independent processes, ten rounds per case with alternating or rotated lane order; no confidence interval or Logue speedup claim.
Release build passes but was not byte-identical to the preexisting build artifact; that artifact was not an independently reconstructed matched baseline. No installation performed.
clock: Darwin CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID = 16, verified against the local SDK; thread CPU, not whole-process CPU
